assertions.subject: major depressive disorder
assertions.quote: The symptoms cause clinically significant distress

assertions.subject: major depressive disorder
assertions.predicate: impairment in social, occupational, or other important areas of functioning
assertions.quote: The symptoms cause clinically significant distress or impairment in social, occupational, or other important areas of functioning

assertions.subject: persistent depressive disorder
assertions.quote: a very limited number of individuals will have depressive symptoms that have persisted longer than 2 years but will not meet criteria for persistent depressive disorder

assertions.subject: major depressive disorder
assertions.predicate: full criteria for a major depressive episode
assertions.quote: If full criteria for a major depressive episode have been met at some point during the current episode of illness, they should be given a diagnosis of major depressive disorder

assertions.subject: persistent depressive disorder
assertions.quote: With pure dysthymic syndrome: Full criteria for a major depressive episode have not been met in at least the preceding 2 years

assertions.subject: persistent depressive disorder
assertions.quote: With persistent major depressive episode: Full criteria for a major depressive episode have been met throughout the preceding 2-year period

assertions.subject: major depressive disorder
assertions.quote: With intermittent major depressive episodes, with current episode: Full criteria for a major depressive episode are currently met, but there have been periods of at least 8 weeks in at least the preceding 2 years with symptoms below the threshold for a full major depressive episode
